labels.old: Impose a tax on family farms
labels.new: Impose a tax on family farms
labels.description: The proposal introduces a specific tax targeting family farms to address inheritance tax avoidance loopholes.

labels.old: Abolish (or reverse) the agricultural property relief and business property relief changes
labels.new: Raise agricultural property relief and business property relief thresholds from £1 million to £2.5 million
labels.description: The proposal increases the tax-free inheritance threshold for agricultural and business assets from £1 million to £2.5 million.

labels.old: Introduce new police powers to address dog attacks on livestock
labels.new: Amend the Dogs (Protection of Livestock) Act 1953 to strengthen legislation against livestock worrying
labels.description: The proposal seeks to update the 1953 Act to better protect farmed animals from dog attacks and expand the scope of offences.

labels.old: Pass legislation to legalise assisted dying
labels.new: Pass the Terminally Ill Adults (End of Life) Bill to legalise assisted dying
labels.description: The proposal seeks to enact legislation allowing terminally ill adults to request assistance in ending their lives.

labels.old: Introduce an independent football regulator
labels.new: Pass the Football Governance Bill to establish an independent football regulator
labels.description: The proposal seeks to create a new independent body to oversee governance and regulation of English football clubs.

labels.old: Introduce a new ownership test and licensing regime for football clubs
labels.new: Establish an independent football regulator with new ownership tests and licensing rules
labels.description: The proposal creates a new independent regulator to enforce financial rules and test club ownership.

labels.old: Increase investment in defence spending
labels.new: Increase defence spending to £2.6 billion in-year cuts
labels.description: The proposal seeks to reverse planned £2.6 billion cuts to the Ministry of Defence's operating budget this year.

labels.old: Extend the armed forces covenant to every area of Government
labels.new: Enshrine the armed forces covenant into law across all areas of Government
labels.description: This proposal legally binds all government departments to consider the unique needs of service personnel and their families.

labels.old: Reform the business rates system
labels.new: Reform the non-domestic rating system in England
labels.description: The proposal seeks to change how businesses in England are taxed on their properties.

labels.old: Deliver a core guarantee of high standards with space for innovation in every child's education
labels.new: Introduce the Children's Wellbeing and Schools Bill
labels.description: The proposal is to pass the Children's Wellbeing and Schools Bill to establish a core educational offer for every child.

labels.old: Impose fines on parents for school absence
labels.new: Impose fines on parents for term-time school holidays
labels.description: The proposal requires parents to pay penalties if they remove their children from school during approved holiday periods.

labels.old: Expand school-based nurseries
labels.new: Establish school-based nurseries in existing school classrooms
labels.description: The proposal involves converting unused space in schools into new nursery facilities to increase childcare capacity.

labels.old: Increase funding for further education colleges
labels.new: Increase 16-to-19 funding rates and provide additional capital for further education colleges
labels.description: The proposal seeks to raise per-student funding rates for 16-to-19 year olds and allocate extra capital to upgrade college infrastructure.

labels.old: Expand and strengthen apprenticeships
labels.new: Expand apprenticeships and technical education
labels.description: The proposal aims to increase the number and quality of apprenticeships and technical education programs.

labels.old: Require home-educated children to be registered with local authorities
labels.new: Require home-educated children to be registered with local authorities
labels.description: The proposal mandates that parents of home-educated children must register them with their local authority.

labels.old: Reform the Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND) system
labels.new: Reform the Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND) system
labels.description: The proposal seeks to overhaul the existing framework for assessing and supporting children with special educational needs and disabilities.

labels.old: Require academies to follow the national curriculum
labels.new: Require academies to follow the national curriculum
labels.description: The proposal mandates that all academies must adhere to the national curriculum requirements.

labels.old: Increase investment in mainstream and special educational needs schools
labels.new: Increase investment in mainstream and special educational needs schools
labels.description: The proposal seeks to raise funding for both mainstream and special educational needs schools to address resource shortages.

labels.old: Abolish a narrow approach to the curriculum in favour of a holistic one
labels.new: Abolish the narrow knowledge-rich curriculum in favour of a holistic approach
labels.description: The proposal seeks to replace the current knowledge-rich curriculum with a broader, holistic educational model.

labels.old: Establish Skills England
labels.new: Establish Skills England as an independent executive agency
labels.description: The proposal creates a new independent executive agency named Skills England to oversee technical education and apprenticeships.

labels.old: Cut funding for the International Baccalaureate (IB)
labels.new: Cut funding for the International Baccalaureate in state schools
labels.description: The proposal seeks to reduce government financial support for state schools offering the International Baccalaureate qualification.

labels.old: Abolish the EBacc
labels.new: Abolish the English Baccalaureate (EBacc) performance measure
labels.description: The proposal seeks to remove the EBacc metric used to assess secondary school performance in England.

labels.old: Implement effective relationship and sex education in schools
labels.new: Implement the Review of Relationship, Sex and Health Education guidance
labels.description: The proposal seeks to update the national guidance for relationship, sex, and health education in schools.

labels.old: Impose VAT on independent school fees
labels.new: Remove tax exemption on independent school fees
labels.description: The proposal removes the zero-rating status for independent school fees to generate revenue for the state education system.

labels.old: Expand access to affordable childcare and early years education
labels.new: Expand funded childcare entitlement from 15 to 30 hours per week
labels.description: The proposal increases the weekly hours of government-funded childcare available to working parents from 15 to 30.

labels.old: Recruit an additional 6,500 teachers
labels.new: Recruit 6,500 additional teachers
labels.description: The proposal is to hire 6,500 new teachers to improve school standards and support inclusive education.

labels.old: Expand technical and vocational pathways and qualifications to all children
labels.new: Expand technical and vocational pathways and qualifications to all children
labels.description: The proposal aims to broaden access to technical and vocational education for every child in the UK.

labels.old: Require teachers to have qualified status
labels.new: Require all teachers in academies to hold qualified teacher status
labels.description: The proposal mandates that every teacher employed by academy schools must possess Qualified Teacher Status.

labels.old: Require local authorities to review and potentially consent to home education for vulnerable children (including those in child protection plans or special schools)
labels.new: Require local authority consent for home education of vulnerable children
labels.description: The proposal mandates that local authorities must approve home education arrangements for children in child protection plans or attending special schools.

labels.old: Limit secondary school pupils to wearing no more than three (or four if a tie is included) different branded items of school uniform per year
labels.new: Cap branded school uniform items to three per year with a fourth allowed for ties
labels.description: The proposal limits secondary school pupils to wearing no more than three different branded uniform items annually, or four if a tie is included.

labels.old: Implement a four-day school week
labels.new: Implement a four-day school week
labels.description: The proposal seeks to reduce the standard school week from five days to four days.

labels.old: Make it harder to turn failing schools into academies
labels.new: Remove automatic requirement for schools requiring improvement to become academies
labels.description: The proposal seeks to end the rule that forces schools needing improvement to immediately convert to academy status.

labels.old: Subsume the functions of IfATE into Skills England
labels.new: Transfer functions of the Institute for Apprenticeships and Technical Education to Skills England
labels.description: The proposal moves the statutory duties of IfATE to a new government body called Skills England.

labels.old: Integrate play into the key stage 1 curriculum
labels.new: Integrate play into the key stage 1 curriculum
labels.description: The proposal requires adding play-based learning activities to the mandatory curriculum for children aged 5 to 7.

labels.old: Require compulsory SEND training for teachers and teaching staff
labels.new: Require compulsory Special Educational Needs and Disabilities training for all teachers and staff
labels.description: The proposal mandates that every teacher and teaching staff member must complete specialized training in Special Educational Needs and Disabilities.

labels.old: Raise tuition fees
labels.new: Raise university tuition fees
labels.description: The proposal seeks to increase the amount students must pay for higher education.

labels.old: Abolish academies
labels.new: Abolish all existing academies and replace them with state-run schools
labels.description: The proposal seeks to end the academy system entirely and return all schools to direct state control.

labels.old: Pass the Children's Wellbeing and Schools Bill
labels.new: Pass the Children's Wellbeing and Schools Bill
labels.description: The proposal is to enact legislation aimed at improving child protection and standardizing school performance measures.

labels.old: Ban mobile phone use in schools
labels.new: Ban mobile phone use in schools
labels.description: The proposal requires all schools to prohibit students from using mobile phones during the entire school day.

labels.old: Abolish level 7 apprenticeships
labels.new: Abolish level 7 apprenticeships
labels.description: The proposal seeks to end the government scheme allowing postgraduate-level apprenticeships.

labels.old: Include financial education in the school curriculum
labels.new: Include financial education in the school curriculum
labels.description: The proposal mandates the inclusion of financial education as a subject within the national school curriculum.

labels.old: Abolish or restrict the right to Education, Health and Care Plans (EHCPs)
labels.new: Abolish or restrict the right to Education, Health and Care Plans
labels.description: The proposal seeks to end or limit the legal entitlement for children with special needs to receive an Education, Health and Care Plan.

labels.old: Introduce breakfast clubs for schools
labels.new: Introduce free breakfast clubs in primary schools
labels.description: The proposal establishes free breakfast clubs for all primary school pupils to improve attendance and reduce hunger.

labels.old: Provide free school meals to children
labels.new: Expand free school meals to lift 100,000 children out of poverty
labels.description: The proposal extends free school meal eligibility to an additional 100,000 children to reduce child poverty.

labels.old: Ban exploitative zero-hours contracts and end fire and rehire practices
labels.new: Ban exploitative zero-hours contracts and end fire and rehire practices
labels.description: The proposal seeks to prohibit zero-hours contracts that do not reflect regular hours and stop employers from firing staff to rehire them at lower pay.

labels.old: Introduce day one rights for workers
labels.new: Introduce day one employment rights and guaranteed hours for workers
labels.description: The proposal establishes unfair dismissal protections and guaranteed hours from the first day of employment for all workers.

labels.old: Require solar panels on new houses
labels.new: Mandatory solar panel installation on all new homes
labels.description: The proposal requires every newly constructed house to be fitted with solar panels.

labels.old: Establish Great British Energy
labels.new: Establish Great British Energy
labels.description: The proposal creates a new publicly owned energy company to generate clean electricity and support community energy schemes.

labels.old: Introduce tougher penalties, ban bonuses for water company executives, and require water companies to cover enforcement costs
labels.new: Introduce the Water (Special Measures) Bill to ban executive bonuses and impose unlimited penalties on water companies
labels.description: The proposal establishes stricter regulations for water companies by prohibiting executive bonuses and allowing unlimited financial penalties for failures.

labels.old: Ban unjustifiable and undeserved bonuses for water company executives
labels.new: Grant Ofwat power to ban undeserved bonuses for water company executives
labels.description: The proposal gives the water regulator Ofwat the authority to prohibit performance-related bonuses for executives of water companies.

labels.old: Hold water companies to account for sewage pollution
labels.new: Enact the Water (Special Measures) Bill to hold water companies accountable for sewage pollution
labels.description: This proposal introduces a specific Act to place failing water companies into special measures and enforce stricter accountability for sewage spills.

labels.old: Transfer planning powers from local councils to mayors
labels.new: Grant mayors new planning powers to intervene in major strategic planning applications
labels.description: The proposal allows mayors to override local councils on specific large-scale development projects.

labels.old: Abolish the two-tier council structure in Lancashire (implement a unitary structure)
labels.new: Abolish the two-tier council structure in Lancashire to implement a unitary structure
labels.description: The proposal seeks to replace the existing two-tier local government system in Lancashire with a single unitary authority.

labels.old: Devolve power to local authorities and communities
labels.new: Pass the English Devolution and Community Empowerment Bill
labels.description: The proposal is to enact legislation that devolves powers to local authorities and communities while creating new strategic bodies.

labels.old: Abolish NHS England
labels.new: Abolish NHS England
labels.description: The proposal seeks to dissolve NHS England to streamline health services and reduce duplication.

labels.old: Implement a single patient record
labels.new: Create a single digital patient record for the NHS
labels.description: The proposal establishes one unified digital record to track patient information across all NHS services.

labels.old: Pass the Assisted Dying Bill
labels.new: Pass the Terminally Ill Adults (End of Life) Bill
labels.description: The proposal allows terminally ill adults with six months to live to request assisted dying.

labels.old: Introduce rent controls
labels.new: Introduce rent caps on annual increases and rents in advance
labels.description: The proposal seeks to limit how much landlords can raise rents each year and restrict upfront rent payments to one month.

labels.old: Abolish section 21 no-fault evictions
labels.new: Abolish section 21 no-fault evictions in the Renters' Rights Bill
labels.description: The proposal seeks to end the legal mechanism allowing landlords to evict tenants without providing a specific reason.

labels.old: Abolish the current asylum system (or: Implement the measures in the Bill)
labels.new: Enact the Illegal Migration Act to curb illegal migration and strengthen border security
labels.description: The proposal seeks to pass legislation that removes the duty to remove illegal entrants and strengthens border controls.

labels.old: Repeal sections of the Illegal Migration Act 2023 and the Safety of Rwanda (Asylum and Immigration) Act 2024
labels.new: Repeal sections 59, 29, and 12 of the Illegal Migration Act 2023
labels.description: The proposal seeks to remove specific clauses that restrict asylum claims and weaken judicial oversight of immigration detention.

labels.old: Repeal the Rwanda scheme
labels.new: Repeal the Safety of Rwanda (Asylum and Immigration) Act 2024
labels.description: The proposal seeks to annul the 2024 legislation that established the legal framework for sending asylum seekers to Rwanda.

labels.old: Introduce new respect orders for persistent offenders
labels.new: Introduce new civil respect orders for persistent antisocial behaviour offenders
labels.description: The proposal creates new civil orders allowing courts to ban adults from specific antisocial activities, with breaches treated as criminal offences.

labels.old: Impose income tax and increase rates on dividends, savings, and property
labels.new: Introduce income tax on dividends, savings, and property income in the Finance Bill
labels.description: The proposal introduces a new income tax charge specifically targeting dividends, savings, and property income within the Finance Bill.

labels.old: Charge VAT on private school fees
labels.new: Remove VAT exemption on private school fees
labels.description: The proposal removes the current exemption from Value Added Tax on fees charged by independent schools.

labels.old: Surrender the Chagos islands to Mauritius
labels.new: Approve the British Indian Ocean Territory Bill to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius
labels.description: The proposal seeks to enact legislation transferring sovereignty of the Chagos Islands from the UK to Mauritius.

labels.old: Ratify the treaty
labels.new: Ratify the British Indian Ocean Territory Bill to establish the Chagos Marine Protected Area
labels.description: The proposal seeks to pass legislation that formally ratifies an international treaty creating a marine protected area in the Chagos archipelago.

labels.old: Abolish or significantly reduce Personal Independence Payment (PIP)
labels.new: Restrict eligibility for Personal Independence Payment and cut its health element
labels.description: The proposal seeks to limit who can receive Personal Independence Payment benefits and remove the health component from Universal Credit.

labels.old: Lift the two-child benefit limit
labels.new: Remove the two-child benefit cap in the Universal Credit system
labels.description: The proposal seeks to eliminate the restriction that limits income support to the first two children of a family.

labels.old: Pass the Bill
labels.new: Pass the Universal Credit and Personal Independence Payment Bill
labels.description: The proposal seeks to pass legislation that raises universal credit allowances and alters personal independence payment eligibility criteria.

labels.old: Ban smartphones in schools
labels.new: Ban mobile phones in schools during the school day
labels.description: The proposal requires schools to prohibit students from using mobile phones while school is in session.

labels.old: Require AI companies to provide transparency regarding the use of creative content in their models
labels.new: Require AI companies to disclose copyrighted works used to train their models
labels.description: The proposal mandates that artificial intelligence developers must reveal which copyrighted materials were used in their training datasets.

labels.old: Create Great British Railways
labels.new: Create Great British Railways
labels.description: Establish a new public body to manage and oversee the United Kingdom's railway network.

labels.old: Take railways back into public ownership
labels.new: Nationalisation of the railways under the Railways Bill
labels.description: The proposal is to transfer railway ownership and operations from private companies to public control.

labels.old: Require the railway to have a target for passenger growth
labels.new: Require the railway to have a target for passenger growth
labels.description: The proposal mandates that the railway operator must set a specific goal to increase the number of passengers.
